# M3-Agent memorization (ByteDance-Seed/M3-Agent-Memorization, a Qwen2.5-Omni thinker) plus the tools around it:
# insightface faces, 3D-Speaker ERes2NetV2 voices, faster-whisper ASR (our swap for Gemini). Python 3.11, CUDA 12.4.
# torch 2.6.0 / torchvision 0.21.0 / torchaudio 2.6.0 come first, from setup_env.sh (as upstream's setup.sh), then
# this complete set, installed without dependency resolution (resolved 2026-11-12 from upstream's pins: the
# transformers commit, qwen-omni-utils 0.0.4, accelerate 0.34.2, insightface 0.7.3, onnxruntime 1.22.1,
# hdbscan 0.8.40, moviepy 2.1.2, pydub 0.25.1, httpx 0.23.0; the rest at spring-2025 versions).
# The transformers commit is upstream's (Qwen2.5-Omni before its release, 4.50.0.dev0). It has no Qwen3, so the
# embedding model runs in the control environment (mmagent/utils/local_backends.py starts it as a helper process).
